translations.web: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”
translations.bsb: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”
translations.kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
translations.asv: of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and Jehovah be with thee.
